newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-INJURY PUTS DAHLIN OUT UNTIL DECEMBER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-INJURY PUTS DAHLIN OUT UNTIL DECEMBER.

text.p: Swedish international striker Martin Dahlin pulled a leg muscle in Sunday's World Cup qualifier against Scotland and will be out of action for several weeks, his club Borussia Moenchengladbach said on Monday.

Moenchengladbach trainer Bernd Krauss said Dahlin, who returned to the Bundesliga late last month from Roma, would not be able to play again until after the league's winter break, which begins in mid-December.

Dahlin was substituted in the 17th minute of Sunday's qualifier, which Sweden lost 1-0. The Swedes do not have another World Cup engagement until April next year when they host the return against Scotland.
